en: Front: A vintage postcard with a large Hungarian tricolor flag (red‑white‑green) on a flagpole against a dark red background. Inside a rectangular inset is a black‑and‑white photograph of a bustling town square with market stalls, crowds of people, multi‑story historic buildings, and a church or town‑hall tower at the right. Under the photo is Hungarian text indicating greetings from Pécs and identifying the square as Széchenyi tér. Back: a typical undivided‑back style postcard layout with printed Hungarian text indicating it is a postcard and the name of the printer/publisher.
